scope: One Liquid CPU profile. Excludes Admin startup, network transfer, asset loading, and browser rendering.
header_root_cause: The unused hello-world section declared a global .icon width of 300px. Its compiled stylesheet was loaded by the theme editor and expanded header action icons to 300px, collapsing the search field.
fix: Scope the starter icon rule to .welcome-content > .icon and explicitly size desktop header action icons.
